core_obligations: Reduce to a single sheaf (proof lines 21831-21841): represent K by a bounded below complex F^bullet; the sheaf case gives F^n = a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F^n with vanishing higher pushforwards, so Leray's acyclicity lemma concludes; hence assume K = F is a single sheaf.
Reformulate (proof lines 21843-21847): the fppf description of the pullback gives a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = F, so it remains to show R^q a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = 0 for q > 0.

Degenerate Leray (proof lines 21848-21856): for a_X = epsilon_X o pi_X the relative Leray spectral sequence applies; the fppf V-C statement gives R^i epsilon_{X,*}(a_X^{-1}F) = 0 for i > 0 with epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F, and the etale cohomological descent gives R^j pi_{X,*}(pi_X^{-1}F) = 0 for j > 0, concluding the proof.
proof_roadmap: Reduce a complex to a single sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma.
Rewrite the composite pushforward by the fppf description of the pullback.
Degenerate the relative Leray spectral sequence with the V-C and etale descent inputs.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the fppf analogue of the cohomological descent statement, for bounded below complexes on the small etale topos (statement lines 21820-21828). The proof (proof lines 21830-21856) follows the pattern of the h and ph cases: reduction to a single sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma, rewriting of the composite pushforward through the fppf description of the pullback, and degeneration of the relative Leray spectral sequence using the fppf V-C statement and the etale cohomological descent. H2: one reduction plus one spectral sequence degeneration, written out.
